scope: Selected boundary closeout, not a whole-project per-function semantic audit

items.reason: Return CreateTexture HRESULT, not LockRect HRESULT; nonzero LockRect skips upload and transfers created texture.
UnlockRect result is ignored by original; do not turn failure into a new load failure.
Null COM vtable, impossible bits/pitch, malformed dimensions/RLE and missing palette still fail safely. These are reconstruction guards, not binary parity claims.
Input service, keyboard, enumeration and enabled audio failure abort initialization; mouse failure does not. Check low return byte.
Create wake events before workers; join workers before freeing resources. Native ownership prevents use-after-free; exact original thread timing is not claimed.
Balance successful COM/timer acquisition and clean partial input/graphics startup; do not reintroduce unbalanced native releases.
Sleep fallback when timer/retry event allocation fails, worker/event creation checks and path bounds remain. No additional gameplay rule; exact exceptional timing not recovered.
Device-level compatibility fallbacks are distinct from application accepting a failed initializer. No backend rewrite in this batch.
Named native file entries now take const char*. Only original C registration aliases convert 32-bit address slots.
SqPlus type/data pair and transferred external reference remain 32-bit ABI records, not ordinary pointers. File layout tags and scalar widths stay unchanged.
Shared property read/write receivers use borrowed void*/const void*, unsigned-char displacement and memcpy stores; no integer address arithmetic internally.
Nine texture descriptors derive offsets from named fields; auto_size writes use the authoritative record view.
Reuse document schema, eliminating duplicate publication integer-pointer span fields; resource method pointer is const void*.
Layer identity, name, flags, position/previous/origin registrations use schema offsets, preserving aliases and component order.
Runtime-selected property displacement, type tags, map key order, aliases, stream virtual offsets and thiscall ABI remain genuine protocols. Do not replace with guessed different fields.
Other VM integer slots, property pointer aliases, stream handles, map/timeline/container boundaries and diagnostic offsets remain; no claim of project-wide pointer elimination.
Real VM and compressed file roundtrip: nested table/array, bool/int/float/string/null omission, empty table, repeated calls, stack balance.

items.reason: Independent little-endian scalar fixture plus independent zlib API verifies writer bytes; hand-built nested stream verifies reader without producer agreement.
Missing path, invalid parent, short/oversized prefix, short payload and truncated table fail; temporary isolated files never touch user saves.
